cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

mechanism: A enthusiastically leads an investigation of A own fault, accommodating B evidence and participation to preserve cooperative authority while displacing culpability.
confusable: Distinguish an innocent helper with suspicious clues from a culprit whose own action is legibly established; do not confuse cooperation with merely praising a clue.
comparison: Vase inquiry must establish A knock as cause, not just repair glue; plant inquiry uses B coffee/sugar evidence to expose A watering while A redirects method.
seedUse: Canonical vase and coffee seeds read critically; protected S01+D13 references remain untouched. New S02 variants must actually yield investigative roles to B.
